body.purpose: Editor prose, note content, settings descriptions. Max line length 70ch.

headline.purpose: Dialog titles, settings section headers, sidebar panel titles.

title.purpose: Sub-section labels, nav section headers, panel sub-titles.

label.purpose: Tab labels, activity icon tooltips, metadata chips, keyboard shortcut hints. Uppercase at 0.04em tracking for metadata labels only.

mono.purpose: All code blocks, inline code, terminal output, frontmatter, math.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Hover lift on interactive cards and draggable elements. The barest grounding shadow.

shadows.name: ambient-large
shadows.purpose: Modals and dialogs. Overlay handles depth; shadow is minimal.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions: button hover, icon swap, opacity toggle.

motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: Panel transitions, fade-in, nav state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action. Quiet Violet background, white label. Tactile feedback on hover and press.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: #B899FF; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; padding: 7px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 0.55rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #9B77F5; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #7d5de0; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B899FF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action. Bone surface background, Ink text. Same shape as primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: #F4F4F5; color: #323843; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; padding: 7px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 0.55rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e8e8ea; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #d8d8db; transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B899FF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Toolbar and activity bar actions. Transparent at rest, Bone on hover. Slate text.

components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: transparent; color: #717178; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1; padding: 6px 10px; border: none; border-radius: 0.55rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #F4F4F5; color: #323843; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B899FF; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item (Active)
components.description: Active state for sidebar navigation items. Violet surface tint, Quiet Violet text.
components.html: Active Note
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 0.375rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-item--active { background: #F0EAFF; color: #B899FF; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item--inactive { background: transparent; color: #717178; } .ds-nav-item--inactive:hover { background: rgba(244,244,245,0.5); color: #323843; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item (Inactive)
components.description: Inactive sidebar nav item. Transparent, Slate text, Bone hover.
components.html: Draft Notes
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 0.375rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-item--inactive { background: transparent; color: #717178; } .ds-nav-item--inactive:hover { background: rgba(244,244,245,0.5); color: #323843; }

components.name: Tab (Active)
components.description: Active editor tab. Bone/muted background, full foreground text, 1px violet bottom underline.
components.html: My Notes.md
components.css: .ds-tab { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; min-width: 96px; max-width: 320px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; border-right: 1px solid #E4E4E8; position: relative; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-tab--active { background: rgba(244,244,245,0.3); color: #323843; } .ds-tab--active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px; background: #B899FF; } .ds-tab--inactive { background: transparent; color: rgba(50,56,67,0.5); } .ds-tab--inactive:hover { background: rgba(244,244,245,0.1); color: rgba(50,56,67,0.8); } .ds-tab-label { flex: 1; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tab-close { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 2px; border: none; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 3px; color: inherit; opacity: 0.6; transition: opacity 150ms, background 150ms; } .ds-tab-close:hover { opacity: 1; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input. Borderless at rest, minimal focus treatment. Height 40px.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #717178; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field-input { height: 40px; padding: 0 8px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #323843; background: #F4F4F5; border: 1px solid #E4E4E8; border-radius: 0.55rem; outline: none; width: 100%; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: #717178; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: #B899FF; background: #FFFFFF; }

components.name: Activity Icon
components.description: 40x40 activity bar icon button. Active: Quiet Violet + left-edge indicator. Inactive: 50% foreground.
components.css: .ds-activity-icon { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: none; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-activity-icon--active { color: #B899FF; } .ds-activity-icon--inactive { color: rgba(50,56,67,0.5); } .ds-activity-icon--inactive:hover { color: #323843; } .ds-activity-indicator { position: absolute; left: 0; width: 2px; height: 32px; background: #B899FF; border-radius: 0 2px 2px 0; }

narrative.overview:
writeme is the tool you return to every day. Not because it demands your attention, but because it never gets in the way. The visual language is built around reliability and restraint: a surface that stays calm whether you are capturing a half-formed idea at 7am or tracing a research thread at midnight. The primary violet accent is present, trustworthy, and quiet. It marks what matters without announcing it.

The system operates in two modes that share one vocabulary. Light mode is a clean workspace: near-white surfaces, dark foreground text, a border language that divides without interrupting. Dark mode is the same workshop after the overhead lights go down: deep charcoal surfaces, the same structural hierarchy, the same violet accent. Neither mode is primary.

IBM Plex Sans carries everything: headings, labels, UI copy, running text. It is humanist, precise, and slightly warm without being decorative. JetBrains Mono handles code. The pairing needs no ornamentation.
keyCharacteristics: Single accent color used for primary actions, active states, and semantic emphasis only.
IBM Plex Sans throughout — no display font pairing.
Nearly flat elevation: shadows are ambient and barely perceptible.
Dynamic font sizing via --default-size CSS variable (default 16px); all spacing scales from it.
Full multi-theme support: light, dark, Catppuccin Mocha, Tokyo Night. Same structural vocabulary in all.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Quiet Violet appears in ≤10% of any given screen surface. It marks the active state, the primary action, the current selection. Its rarity is the point. When everything is purple, nothing is.

rules.name: The Semantic-Only Rule
rules.body: Alert Red, Amber, Leaf, and Sky are reserved for their semantic states. They are never used decoratively or for section headers.

rules.name: The Single-Family Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Sans carries headings, UI, and body. No display family is added. Hierarchy is expressed through weight (400/500/600/700) and size, not through font switching.

rules.name: The Scale-Root Rule
rules.body: Every size and spacing value derives from --default-size. Do not introduce hard-coded pixel values that break user-adjustable font sizing.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear only in response to state (hover, floating, modal). Resting surfaces are flat. A shadow that is always visible is a border that failed to commit.

rules.name: The Backdrop Rule
rules.body: backdrop-blur-sm is used on the sidebar panel to create tonal separation from the editor surface. This is purposeful (depth signal, not decoration) and is the only use of blur in the system. Blur on cards or popovers is banned.

dos: Do use Quiet Violet (#B899FF) exclusively for interactive primary states, active navigation, and semantic emphasis.
Do derive every size and spacing value from --default-size.
Do keep resting surfaces flat. Add shadow only when an element has been lifted by state.
Do use IBM Plex Sans for all UI text including headings.
Do keep the activity bar at 40px and icon-only. Tooltips are the label surface.
Do support prefers-reduced-motion for every animation in the product.
Do use semantic color tokens for all state: danger for errors, warn for warnings, success for confirmations.
donts: Don't add gradient fills, glassmorphism cards, or purple-to-teal gradients. If it looks like an AI startup landing page, it's wrong.
Don't use backdrop-blur anywhere except the sidebar panel.
Don't produce dev tool brutalism: monospace-everything, gray-on-gray, no visual warmth.
Don't create sparse, empty designs that feel like a blog theme.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored stripe on cards, list items, callouts, or alerts.
Don't use any hardcoded color that is not a design token reference or CSS custom property.
Don't animate CSS layout properties. Animate opacity and transform only.
